sentences.en: Did you have your photograph taken for the driver's license?
sentences.zh: 你驾照的照片拍好了吗？

sentences.en: This yearbook is illustrated with a lot of beautiful photographs.
sentences.zh: 今年的年鉴里有很多漂亮的照片。

sentences.en: When I see this photograph, I think of my family.
sentences.zh: 看到这张照片我就想起我的家人。
